title: Vanilla+
description: a modpack that adds many things that are not in Minecraft and a few more to make the gameplay more enjoyable
body:
Better Vanilla is a modpack designed to enhance the classic Minecraft experience without changing its core feeling. It keeps the game simple and familiar while improving performance, visuals, and quality of life.

This pack focuses on making vanilla gameplay smoother and more enjoyable. It includes optimizations for higher FPS, improved animations, better textures, and small tweaks that make the game feel more modern.

Perfect for players who want:

A cleaner and smoother Minecraft experience
Better performance without losing the vanilla style
Enhanced visuals and animations
Quality of life improvements without heavy mods

Whether you're building, exploring, or playing survival, this modpack gives you a fresh but still vanilla-like experience.
